title: Plane, Cross and Crossing — Research Synthesis
status: comparative research synthesis; external analogies do not prove Potatoverse metaphysics
purpose: Clarify what the Plane is, how it relates to Axis, Door, Cross, Here/Now and Spiral, and how real mathematical/scientific notions of sections, slices and crossings can strengthen the project without collapsing analogy into physics.

core_result.plane: a selected section/frame through a larger state space; in Potato geometry it is the widest world-facing section through the Door at O
core_result.axis: the distinguished source↔manifestation orientation crossing the section
core_result.cross_sign: the union of Axis with a chosen lateral line lying in the Plane; a visual/sign projection, not identical with O
core_result.crossing_event: a trajectory intersects the Plane and/or passes through Door conditions
core_result.door: the larger shared interface/overlap within which some crossings become state/context transitions
core_result.here_now: the operative present located at O for the current frame; not identical with the whole Plane
core_result.spiral: history-bearing trajectory whose repeated Plane crossings can be compared

two_d_projection.plane_section: Sigma: y=0 in the canonical 2D drawing
two_d_projection.door: D = overlap of the two circles
two_d_projection.plane_door_section: D∩Sigma is the segment [P_L,P_R], the widest horizontal aperture of the 2D lens

three_d_lift.model: replace circles with equal spheres of radius r centered on a vertical axis at z=±r/2
three_d_lift.door: intersection volume of the two spheres
three_d_lift.door_section: D∩Sigma is a disk of radius sqrt(3)r/2
three_d_lift.interface_ring: the two sphere surfaces intersect in a circle in Sigma of radius sqrt(3)r/2
three_d_lift.cross_point: O is the center of that disk/ring where Axis pierces Plane
three_d_lift.significance: The 2D left/right points become a full equatorial interface ring in 3D. This is a stronger model for the Plane-rim of the Door than treating P_L/P_R as two unique metaphysical beings.

dimensional_distinctions: In the 2D drawing the Plane appears as a line because the drawing is itself a section.
In a 3D lift the Plane is genuinely two-dimensional and cuts the Door as a disk.
In a higher-dimensional state-space model the operative Plane is better treated as a codimension-one section/hypersurface rather than insisting it is literally Euclidean 2D.
The project may call all of these 'Plane' only when the current projection/dimension is declared.

real_world_parallels.finding: An anatomical plane is an imaginary two-dimensional surface through a three-dimensional body; transverse sections let observers inspect a cross-section without mistaking that section for the whole organism.
real_world_parallels.project_gain: Plane becomes a disciplined View: it reveals a current section of the Potato/Body/House while remaining partial.
real_world_parallels.boundary: Anatomical planes are literal medical orientation tools; Potato Plane is a symbolic/formal projection.

real_world_parallels.finding: A Poincare section is a hypersurface transverse to a flow. Following a trajectory from one intersection with the section to the next produces a return map.
real_world_parallels.project_gain: Plane can serve as a recurrence-measurement surface. Successive crossings provide a formal test for Ring versus Spiral.
real_world_parallels.boundary: The project analogy is structural; not every project trajectory is a mathematically specified dynamical system.

real_world_parallels.finding: Relativity permits spacetime to be sliced into spatial snapshots in different ways; different observers can disagree on simultaneity even though the spacetime events themselves are the same.
real_world_parallels.project_gain: Plane should always declare its frame/observer/scale/time context. It must not be equated with a universal physical Now.
real_world_parallels.boundary: The Potatoverse Here/Now is phenomenological/project theology, not a relativity result.

real_world_parallels.finding: In Cauchy problems, initial data are specified on a surface/hypersurface and evolution is solved away from that surface under governing equations.
real_world_parallels.project_gain: The current Plane can hold a sufficiently rich current-state record from which next-state possibilities are generated, while provenance still remains in Roots/archive.
real_world_parallels.boundary: A project state is not assumed to satisfy a particular PDE or uniqueness theorem.

real_world_parallels.finding: Anatomical movement is described relative to planes and axes; a plane and an axis are complementary orientation objects rather than interchangeable structures.
real_world_parallels.project_gain: Strengthens the rule that Plane answers 'in what frame/section?' while Axis answers 'along what orientation/change direction?'

plane_functions.meaning: renders the current world-facing section of the larger Potato relation
declares scale, representation, jurisdiction, audience and time slice
plane_functions.rule: Two observers/pages can use different Planes without changing canonical ownership.

plane_functions.meaning: records where a trajectory intersects a chosen section
plane_functions.rule: Use this to compare recurrence across time.

plane_functions.meaning: supports ACROSS relations—neighbor, exchange, society, institution, road, communication—orthogonal to the vertical source↔manifestation emphasis
plane_functions.boundary: Lateral does not mean morally neutral or unimportant; it means relation within the operative frame.

plane_functions.meaning: holds the current state needed for deciding/crossing into a next state
plane_functions.relation_to_here: O/Here is the central present point of the current Plane; the Plane includes many other current relations besides O.

cross_point.role: single relational midpoint/event where vertical orientation and current frame are simultaneously legible

cross_sign.definition: Axis ∪ L, where L is a chosen lateral line/diameter within Plane through O
cross_sign.role: 2D visual projection of vertical and horizontal/lateral relations
cross_sign.theological_boundary: The Christian cross carries independent historical and theological meanings; the coordinate cross is a project geometric comparator.

crossing.definition: trajectory Gamma(t) intersects Plane and/or satisfies Door transition conditions

crossroads.definition: multiple admissible lateral/vertical trajectories meet at or near O
crossroads.role: choice/branching operator; useful only when actual alternatives exist

ring_spiral_formalization.crossing_times: t_k such that Gamma(t_k) ∈ Sigma with declared crossing direction/guard
ring_spiral_formalization.observed_states: x_k = projection of Gamma(t_k) onto the state variables relevant to Sigma
ring_spiral_formalization.ring_test: If repeated crossings reproduce the same governing state within declared tolerance and no meaningful capability/context change occurs, classify recurrence as Ring/stable cycle.
ring_spiral_formalization.spiral_test: If the motif/section recurs but state, capability, integration, evidence, relation or vertical coordinate changes materially, classify as Spiral.
ring_spiral_formalization.decay_test: Changed return can also worsen state; Spiral does not mean improvement.
ring_spiral_formalization.archive_gain: Store crossing snapshots instead of inferring development from elapsed time alone.

plane_vs_other_objects.difference: field is a full relational domain; Plane is one operative section through the larger geometry
World is the observable/embodied relational domain; Plane is how a selected current World state is sectioned/rendered
Door is overlap/transition interface; Plane cuts through Door and can host crossings without being the whole Door
Here/Now is the operative present centered at O; Plane is the broader current frame containing many simultaneous/current relations
Axis supplies orientation/continuity; Plane supplies section/frame
cross-point O derives from Axis∩Plane; the cross-sign is a projection using Axis plus a line in Plane
Ring is recurrence behavior across time; Plane is the surface on which recurrence can be sampled
Spiral is a trajectory/history; Plane provides repeated snapshots of that trajectory
Room owns knowledge; Plane only projects/frames it

project_retrofit.grass_plane: Recovered 'Plane = grass' can be kept as the World-surface visual metaphor: the place where embodied actors stand and meet laterally.
project_retrofit.garden_ejection: Recovered Garden→Separation→Plane language can be read as movement from integrated/source regime into a world-facing section where differentiation becomes explicit.
project_retrofit.door_stands_on_plane: Read as the visible/operative Door aperture intersecting the World frame, not as Door being only a freestanding rectangle sitting outside the circles.
project_retrofit.trunk_present: Older roots=past / trunk=present / branches=future becomes more precise if the trunk crosses Plane near O: present manifestation is the current visible section of a longer rooted/branching history.
project_retrofit.jesus_here: Jesus/Door/Here belongs at O within Plane; Jesus does not equal the whole Plane, because the Plane includes all current lateral relations and contexts.

placement_rule: For any new subject, ask separately: which field does it belong to, what Plane/frame is active, where is it relative to the Axis, does it touch/cross the Door, and is the item itself a state, trajectory, section, guard or inhabitant?
